seed1_control_to_augmented.summary: Five of six directional measures improve and unpermuted development gains sharply, but development NLL regresses slightly, train fit falls, TV remains above 0.20, and the 32/57 action gate is missed by one.

new_information.contrast_with_seed0: Seed 0 substantially reduced probability movement but regressed development agreement and replaced an index-0 shortcut with an index-3 shortcut. Seed 1 instead improves development choices and semantic invariance. The treatment effect is therefore genuinely training-seed-heterogeneous rather than a clear repeated failure.

decision: The seed-1 result meets the sequential policy's promising-or-genuinely-ambiguous trigger. Train only the already-matched seed-2 augmented arm through the fixed step-1500 endpoint, then score the same direct train/development/cyclic battery and close COMP-015. Do not add further seeds.
decision_value: Seed 2 will decide whether cyclic augmentation is carried into a separately frozen move-choice-weighting combination or dropped as unstable. It cannot restore the original strict success claim or authorize behaviour.

training_contract.consumed_schedule: the exact first 1500 rows of the already-frozen 3000-row seed-2 augmented dataset

unit_weight_compatibility_audit.equivalence: Tokens, boolean masks, serialized row order, fixed source schedule, batch size, padding, loss operation, optimizer construction, and iteration order match the historical unit-weight path. New adapter/config provenance fields do not enter model or optimizer computation.
unit_weight_compatibility_audit.limitation: The treatment adapter directory cannot be byte-identical to a historical run because its provenance files explicitly record the current source and weighting support.

close_decision_rule.carry_cyclic_augmentation_forward_if: Relative to the matched seed-2 control, treatment does not regress unpermuted direct development agreement, improves semantic top-1 invariance by at least 0.20, reduces probability total variation by at least 0.10, improves cyclic source-macro teacher agreement by at least 0.10, and reduces cyclic source-macro NLL by at least 0.25.
close_decision_rule.drop_cyclic_augmentation_if: Treatment regresses unpermuted development agreement or fails at least two of the four cyclic improvement thresholds.
close_decision_rule.mixed_if: Development does not regress and exactly three of the four cyclic thresholds pass; report the residual ambiguity, do not add seeds, and defer any combination until weight 8 independently passes.
close_decision_rule.regardless: Close COMP-015 after this pair. No COMP-015 behaviour or final-cohort release is permitted.
